title: The two tan values from the quadratic
caption: Replacing sec²x gives 2tan²x − 3tan x − 1 = 0, so tan x = (3 ± √17)/4 ≈ 1.781 or -0.281. On 0° ≤ x < 180° each value meets the tangent graph once: x ≈ 60.7° and x ≈ 164.3°.
alt: The tangent graph from 0° to 180° in two branches. The line y = 1.781 meets the first branch at about 60.7° and the line y = −0.281 meets the second branch at about 164.3°.
description: The quadratic in tan x has roots tan x ≈ 1.781 and tan x ≈ −0.281.
tan x = 1.781 gives x ≈ 60.7° on the first branch.
tan x = −0.281 is negative, so it lies on the second branch: x = 180° − 15.7° ≈ 164.3°.
